<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Ways to get help as cards or rows, each with an icon, a title, a sentence and an open link. Axes: layout
  (grid, list), columns, action (link, none), tone (default, muted).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

export type SupportChannelsProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  channels: Feature[];
  empty?: string;
  open: string;
  layout?: "grid" | "list";
  cols?: "1-2" | "1-3";
  action?: "link" | "none";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Card from "../compose/Card.vue";
import CardContent from "../compose/CardContent.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  channels,
  empty = "",
  open,
  layout = "grid",
  cols = "1-3",
  action = "link",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<SupportChannelsProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((channels?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="life-buoy" :title="empty" />
    <Grid v-else :cols="(((layout as string) === 'list') ? '1' : cols)" class="gap-4" data-slot="items">
      <Card
        v-for="c in channels"
        :key="c.id"
        variant="default"
        :class="cn('h-full', (((layout as string) === 'list') ? 'flex-row items-center' : ''))"
      >
        <CardContent :class="cn('flex flex-1 gap-4', (((layout as string) === 'list') ? 'items-center' : 'flex-col'))">
          <LucideIcon :name="c.icon" :size="24" />
          <Stack gap="2" class="flex-1">
            <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="bold">
              {{ c.title }}
            </Title>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ c.text }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <MenuEntry v-if="((action as string) === 'link')" :href="c.href" class="font-semibold" testid="open">
            {{ open }}
          </MenuEntry>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
